eligibility_policy: whole headline retained only if every annotation in every variant fits in full within 128 tokens, has nonempty known-token sequences and exact decoded text; reject overflow rather than crop the target context
identity_substitution_stress_checks: separate follow-up development diagnostic; not a selection metric and not implemented in tokenizer preparation
initialization: fresh original base snapshot and seeded three-class head for each trial; same initial state/RNG per seed across variants; no adapted checkpoint reuse
limitations: validation reused for development and epoch selection
literal alignment does not establish entity identity or coreference
replacement leaves other contextual identity clues
filtered subset excludes difficult span cases
new variant claims require fresh independent evaluation; consumed test remains untouched
marker_policy: ordinary [TARGET] and [/TARGET] text; no new vocabulary, no embedding resize, no MLM mask tokens
native_identity_policy: seen/unseen uses exact original native target strings in retained training annotations, never transformed target text

optimization.decay_policy: exclude bias and LayerNorm.weight from weight decay
optimization.precision: FP32; eager attention; deterministic; TF32 disabled
optimization.scheduler: linear decay with warmup; warmup steps floor(total maximum steps * warmup_ratio)
optimization.shuffle: seeded torch Generator; num_workers=0; same common-epoch example ID order across variants

pair_policy: native tokenizer target first, headline second; right padding; only_second truncation; full target retained
probability_policy: raw softmax; ECE 10 equal-width top-label bins; unnormalized multiclass Brier; no temperature fitting
reporting: report every trial, model architecture/parameter count/saved bytes/timing, mean and sample standard deviation across all three seeds, and same-seed macro F1 differences against the freshly trained subset-matched target_pair baseline
scope: native SEntFiN development only; company detection deferred
selection: each trial selects strict highest all-retained-target validation macro F1; earliest epoch on exact tie; patience from pinned training config; no best-seed selection
